assembly_notes: A pictureX_0611 lid opener is one fixed stamped stainless `frame` (working-head carrier, lower handle tang, molded lower grip, main pivot pin) and one moving `lever` (stamped lever plate, moving jaw finger, upper tang, molded upper grip), joined by a single bounded REVOLUTE `handle_pivot` about the vertical carrier axis (0,0,1) solved by mate_axes and registered with register_interface_mate. Negative pivot values squeeze the handles together, which -- because the head is on the far side of the pivot -- drives the moving jaw finger toward the carrier's fixed upper lip; positive values open the tool. Range -0.30 .. +0.26 rad, full travel, never clamped. The `head` slot owns the joint graph: rotary_crank adds three CONTINUOUS Z rotors (drive gear + crank/knob, feed wheel, cutter disc), feed_gear adds one CONTINUOUS serrated feed rotor plus a static cutting wheel, lever_cutter parents the sharpened cutting wheel to the MOVING lever with static reduction/feed gears on the frame, and guarded_head is all-static under a folded U guard. Cross-component derivations are recorded here rather than as bindings because both endpoints of every one of them hang off the shared non-slotted `frame` / `lever` hosts, which are not declared component slots: frame_to_lever_pivot: frame.pivot_axis -> lever.pivot_bore (revolute); the pin top is derived to lever_plate_z0 + 0.0006 so it is really seated in the lever plate. | frame_to_rotor_shaft_i: frame.shaft_axis_i -> head.rotor_axis (continuous); station_i and radius_i are derived from head_span_m and each rotor hub bottom is derived to carrier_top - 0.0006. | carrier_to_mouth: the mouth outline/hole is derived from mouth_x = -(head_span_m + 0.012) and mouth_size_m, so the head slot and the mouth slot never contend for the same carrier region. | tang_to_grip: frame_tang_reach / lever_tang_reach are derived from grip_length_m so either grip family stays bridged to its stamped half. Layering contract that makes the full 4x4x2x2 cartesian product buildable without any overlap allowance: every frame element except the pivot pin ends at or below z=0.0100 and every lever element starts at or above z=0.0110, so the two plier halves only ever meet at the pivot, and there the contact is a 0.6 mm vertical lap whose world-AABB depth on Z stays under the collision tolerance. No multiplicity: none of the four records repeats a structural unit a variable number of times.

candidates.evidence: Three spinning shafts on the stamped cheek: cutter disc + axle (L269-292), serrated feed wheel + axle (L295-318) and a spur drive gear with a short crank arm and molded knob (L321-372). The only record with a hand crank and more than one rotary axis.
candidates.name: rotary_crank
candidates.notes: Emits three CONTINUOUS Z rotor parts; the crank sweep envelope is derived to clear the feed wheel.

parameters.name: head_span_m
parameters.rationale: Pivot-to-mouth span of the working head; drives every gear station, radius and the carrier nose.

parameters.name: mouth_x
parameters.rationale: Working-mouth centre on the nose axis, so the mouth slot always lands past the head hardware.

parameters.name: drive_r
parameters.rationale: Drive-gear radius derived from the head span; the station is -0.34 * head_span_m.

parameters.name: feed_r
parameters.rationale: Feed-wheel radius; its station -0.66 * head_span_m keeps a >= 0.10 * head_span gap from the drive gear.

parameters.name: cutter_r
parameters.rationale: Cutter-disc radius at station (-0.62 * head_span_m, 0.019).

candidates.evidence: One serrated `feed_gear` part on a CONTINUOUS `gear_rotation` axis (L261-291) beside a STATIC cutter bracket, sharpened cutting wheel and cutter screw fixed to the cheek (L167-184): 1 revolute + 1 continuous joint topology.

candidates.evidence: The stamped carrier's working mouth is cut as a circle unioned with a squared `mouth_exit` box (L91-102), leaving an open crescent throat, and a rubber `jaw_pad` protects the lid rim on the lower lip (L201-206).

candidates.notes: Replaces the nose face with a 0.45*mouth_size arc, leaving two jaw tips.

parameters.name: frame_tang_reach
